_meta.note: digital_buy_share = L3M digital buy / (buy_gmv_estimated/4). digital_sell_share = L3M online sell / (gmv_reference/4). Caps at 1.0. null = no GMV estimate. take_rate = fees_ytd_2026 / online_sell_ytd_2026. fees_ytd from fees_monthly month=2026-01 rows (YTD aggregate). bunches_reality = from SALE_DETAILS (high confidence). bunches_config = config flag (unreliable — Rose Data Rule: config != reality). bunches_discrepancy = True if config OFF but account sells bunches in reality. kickoff_date: Priority 1=first buy month−30d (first_procurement_tx), Priority 2=christine days_live→go_live−30d (christine_estimate). purchases_first_30d = buy_online GMV proxy (order count unavailable). m1_met = buy_online > 0 in first or second month from kickoff. procurement_l3m / procurement_prior_l3m = total buy GMV (online+offline). procurement_trend = l3m/prior_l3m − 1.

summary.m1_note: m1_met = buy_online GMV > 0 in first or second month from kickoff. Order-level count unavailable (buy_monthly is monthly aggregate only). Threshold '20 purchases' cannot be verified; GMV presence used as proxy.
summary.m5_note: bunches.json has sells_bunches (bool) and total GMV only — no unit/channel split. sell_monthly has no format/channel indicator separating units from boxes. Reference value: ~1.5% units online (external source, Jul 2026).
